properties.property: Only the immutable factory can initialize once; implementation storage is locked.
Accounted quote equals unspent entry receipts; direct donations are excluded from liabilities.
Tickets form contiguous disjoint ranges that cover [1,totalEntries].
ticketCount <= totalEntries <= uint128.max; each purchase adds at least one entry.
grossSales <= uint128.max * 1000000 and percentage allocations remain within uint256.
An accepted VRF word selects one entry covered by exactly one historical range.
properties.result: holds; modulo bias is negligible at the uint128 cap

properties.property: Only the immutable wrapper can reach the random-word handler.
Only the recorded request before its deadline resolves a Drawing raffle; duplicate, late, in-flight, and wrong-length callbacks do not resolve.
Buying, draw initiation, and full-refund availability use consistent exclusive boundaries.
NftWon, CashWon, and Refunding cannot return to Active or Drawing.
Settlement consumes unsettledPot once without ownership reads or asset transfers.
NFT payout is 95/5 and cash payout is 80/15/5; allocations sum to the sale pot.
Only the current winning-ticket owner receives the prize; approvals alone do not permit redemption.
A failed redemption or refund transfer restores the burn, balances, liabilities, and claim flags.
Each surviving owner may burn each ticket once for its full represented entry value.
Refund batches require 1..100 tickets and duplicates, foreign tickets, or nonexistent IDs revert.
Sponsor, treasury, and winner releases cannot consume each other's quote allocations.
One prizeClaimed flag gates the winner NFT branch and sponsor return branches.
Inherited ticket transfers change ownership but preserve entry ranges, totalEntries, and liabilities.
Each money-mutating public path uses the same clone-local guard; burn precedes prize calls.
Draw requester funds the actual fee and receives only its own excess; rejected refunds revert the request.
properties.result: holds; forced donations remain outside claims
